title: 第4章 今日之辱，来日十倍讨之

第一卷 第四章 今日之辱，来日十倍讨之

所谓圣生，就是指在四十年内有机会进阶“圣阶”的超级天赋学生。

经过三个月来对这个世界的了解，刘枫现在也大概知道了“圣阶”高手在夜阑大陆上的地位。

在这片强者为尊，弱肉强食的大陆上，任何崇高的地位都是建立在相应的实力之上，想要得到旁人的尊重，你就得表现出比旁人还要强的力量。

现在的夜阑大陆，拥有三位至尊阶高手和四位圣阶高手，人们称他们为“三尊四圣”。

“三尊四圣”在大陆上的地位极为崇高，就算帝国的国王与之相见也要执鞠躬礼，以示尊重。

“三尊四圣”约定过一般不会插手大陆各帝国之间战事，除非是外族入侵，如大陆北方的比蒙帝国，东边的海族，还有那传说之中的魔族。。。

但是他们拥有重量级的话语权，他们的话，各大帝国之间也不敢轻易忽视，更何况“三神四圣”中的四圣在五十年前，建立了四所名满大陆的“四大学院”，当真算的上是门生遍天下，拥有这样的潜势力，大陆上谁敢忽视？

至于三大至尊么，那已经是步入了“神”的境界。人数的多少在他们眼中已并无多少区别。

薇儿现在便是大陆四大学院之中的“星蓝学院”这届的圣生。

哈克老爹在小镇上开了一家小小的酒馆，因为这里临近“死亡森林”，平常很多冒险者和佣兵在来往到此狩猎魔兽，所以酒馆生意还是很不错。

刘枫打着哈欠摇晃晃的走下了楼时，楼下已是人声鼎沸，哈克老爹正在柜台边招呼客人，见刘枫下得楼来，忙喊道：“啊枫，你个臭小子，还不去招呼客人，想累死我啊。”

刘枫嘿嘿笑道：“哈克老爹，你现在正是老当益壮啊，哪来的累死之说，你看你，简直比我还有精神哩。”

“你小子一天就知道油嘴滑舌，还不去干活。”哈克老爹笑骂道，作势欲打。

“嘿嘿，”刘枫笑了笑，忙端着盘子向人群穿梭而去。

“嘿，黑发小子，给我来一瓶果酒。”

“妈的，我告诉你们，我们血狼佣兵团上次在死亡森林遇到一只五阶烈魔豹，结果，我们挂了八个兄弟才把那头杂种搞定，不过，那头魔豹的魔晶也卖了一千金币，也算是值了。”一壮汉光着膀子，正在向身边的人大声吹嘘着，口水四溅。

底下众人听得也是惊呼不已，毕竟一头五阶的魔兽都已经可以轻松的灭掉一只稍弱的佣兵团了。

刘枫一边在人群穿梭，一边听着众人吹嘘自己的功绩。

“呼，累死我了，终于可以歇息了，”喘着气的趴在柜台上，刘枫对哈克老爹抱怨道：“老爹，你太可恶了，这么多的客人，连一个伙计都舍不得请，就知道剥削我。”

“嘿嘿，请伙计不要钱啊，年轻人啊，多做点，我是为你好，”哈克老爹奸笑道。

刘枫翻了翻白眼，甩给了他一个中指。

“唧呀”，酒馆大门再次被推开，众人不由停下交谈，目光飘向大门。

看着门口亭亭玉立女孩，酒馆里，一片寂静。

绝美的脸庞，一双紫艳得妖异的美瞳在流转间，散发出纯天然的魅惑，齐及腰身的紫色青丝柔顺的披在香肩之上，紧身的紫色女剑士服，把她那玲珑丰满的娇躯展现得淋漓尽致。

“若说薇儿现在是“校花”级别，那么眼前的美女那便是真正的“祸水”级别”。刘枫在心中暗道，不过随既又加了一句，“不过，薇儿现在才十七，还有非常大的成长空间，若再等得俩年，不会比她差，甚至。。。更美。。”

酒馆里的冒险者们何时见过这么漂亮的美女，顿时，哨声掀起了酒馆，狼嚎四起。

“美女，来喝俩杯怎么样，哈哈。”

“这小妞身材真棒，比我上次去的那飘香楼里的红牌小姐的都要好啊。”

听见酒馆里的污言晦语，紫衣美女俏脸一寒，斗气猛的从体内迸发出来，耀眼的紫色骄傲的向众人表达出了它的阶级，七阶。

“七阶”是他们这群小小佣兵只能仰望的存在，这里的冒险者最高的阶级连四阶都没，连人家一招都接不下。

强者为尊的规则，再次出现在这里。

红衣美女轻声哼了声：“一群软骨头。”

红衣美女莲步微移，来到柜台前，却看见一张平凡的白皙脸庞，黑色头发？俩眼相对，红衣美女俏脸一怒，寒声道：你在看什么？”

“看你胸。。额。。祢做什么？”刘枫话还未落，却见美女一只玉手向脸上煽来，练了几天内功的刘枫身手和眼力还是提高了许多，脑袋微偏，躲了过去。

见一击不中，美女略微意外，左手闪电般的抓住刘枫手腕，一提，再一甩，重重的摔在了地上。

红衣美女冷声哼道：“原来是个“魔武废人”，竟然还这么嚣张。”

“MD，劳资看的你胸口上的徽章，不是看你，傻婆娘。”刘枫抬头怒道。的确，刘枫可是说的实话，他刚刚看的是她胸前佩带的徽章，是一颗雕刻着美丽的蓝色星辰。

红衣美女柳眉倒竖，嘴唇动了动，却并没有出声，也许在她眼中，一个魔武废人并不值得她这样浪费口舌。

从刘枫身前走了过去，忽然顿了一下，从口袋里拿出几个金币丢在身下。

本来也算是一片好心的她，却却不知道这番动作，在刘枫心中，侮辱性比刚才还要甚之。

心中怒气狂涌，拳头紧握，指甲深深刺进了掌身，看着那在眼前打着旋的金币，似乎变成了一个个嘲讽的微笑。

心中猛的冒出一个念头，“冲上去，跟她拼了，要她付出侮辱你的代价。”虽然，刘枫很想这样做，但理智迅速告诉他，自己现在的力量根本不是她的对手，思量片刻后，刘枫选择了隐忍，他深深的明白一个道理，“君子报仇，十年不晚。”

单手支地，抹去嘴角的一丝鲜血，对着红衣美女轻轻的寒声说道：“今日之辱，来日十倍讨之。”

听到这句冰冷入骨的语言，紫衣美女心中冥冥之中似乎忽然闪过一丝不安与。。惧怕？

美目闪动了一下，似乎想要出声，可是最后她的高傲却阻止了到了嘴边的话语，只是轻轻点了点头。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 4 Today’s humiliation will be repaid tenfold in the future

The so-called saint students refer to super talented students who have the opportunity to advance to the "holy level" within forty years.

After three months of understanding the world, Liu Feng now roughly knows the status of "holy level" masters on Yelan Continent.

In this continent where the strong are respected and the weak eat the strong, any lofty status is based on corresponding strength. If you want to be respected by others, you have to show that you are stronger than others.

Currently, Yelan Continent has three supreme level masters and four holy level masters. People call them the "Three Saints and Four Saints".

The status of the "Three Saints and Four Saints" on the mainland is extremely high. Even if the king of the empire meets them, they must bow to show respect.

The "Three Saints and Four Saints" have agreed not to interfere in the wars between the empires on the mainland, unless there is an invasion by foreign tribes, such as the Beamon Empire in the north of the continent, the Sea Clan in the east, and the legendary Demon Clan...

But they have a heavy say, and their words are not easily ignored by the major empires. What's more, the Four Saints among the "Three Gods and Four Saints" established four "Four Colleges" that are famous all over the continent fifty years ago. They really have students all over the world. With such potential power, who on the mainland dares to ignore it?

As for the three supreme beings, they have already entered the realm of "gods".The number of people no longer makes much difference in their eyes.

Wei'er is now a saint student of "Xinglan College", one of the four major colleges in mainland China.

Daddy Harker opened a small tavern in the town. Because it is close to the "Death Forest", many adventurers and mercenaries usually come here to hunt Warcraft, so the tavern business is still very good.

When Liu Feng yawned and staggered downstairs, there was already a lot of people downstairs. Daddy Huck was greeting the customers at the counter. Seeing Liu Feng coming downstairs, he hurriedly shouted: "Ah Feng, you stinky boy, you don't go to greet the customers, you want to tire me to death."

Liu Feng chuckled and said: "Dad Huck, you are getting stronger and stronger now. How can you say that you are exhausted? Look at you, you are more energetic than me."

"You've learned to be glib and talkative in just one day, and you still don't get to work." Father Huck scolded with a smile, as if he was ready to fight.

"Hehe," Liu Feng smiled and hurriedly carried the plate and walked towards the crowd.

"Hey, black-haired boy, bring me a bottle of fruit wine."

"Damn it, let me tell you, our blood wolf mercenary group encountered a fifth-level demonic leopard in the Death Forest last time. As a result, we had to kill eight brothers to get rid of that bastard. However, the demonic leopard's magic crystal was sold for a thousand gold coins, so it was worth it." A shirtless man was bragging loudly to the people around him, salivating.

Everyone below heard this and exclaimed in surprise. After all, a fifth-level monster could easily destroy a weaker mercenary group.

Liu Feng was walking among the crowd while listening to everyone bragging about his achievements.

"Phew, I'm exhausted. I can finally rest." Liu Feng lay on the counter panting and complained to Daddy Huck: "Dad, you are so disgusting. You have so many customers and you don't even want to hire a waiter, so you know how to exploit me."

"Hehe, please don't pay me, young man, do more, I'm doing it for your own good," said Father Huck with a sinister smile.

Liu Feng rolled his eyes and gave him a middle finger.

"Hey!" The door of the tavern was pushed open again. Everyone couldn't help but stop talking and their eyes drifted towards the door.

Looking at the slim girl at the door, there was silence in the tavern.

With her absolutely beautiful face and a pair of enchanting purple colored eyes, she exuded pure natural charm. Her waist-length purple hair was draped softly over her shoulders, and her tight-fitting purple swordswoman uniform showed off her exquisite and plump figure to the fullest.

"If Weier is now a "school beauty", then the beauty in front of her is a real "disaster"."Liu Feng secretly thought in his heart, but then added, "However, Wei'er is only seventeen now, and there is still a lot of room for growth. If she waits for another two years, she will not be worse than her, and even... more beautiful..."

The adventurers in the tavern had never seen such a beautiful beauty. Suddenly, the whistle blew up the tavern, and wolves howled everywhere.

"Beauty, how about a couple of drinks, haha."

"This girl has a great figure. She's even better than the red card lady in the Piaoxiang Building I went to last time."

Hearing the dirty words in the tavern, the pretty face of the purple-clothed beauty froze, and fighting spirit burst out from her body. The dazzling purple color proudly expressed her rank, seventh level, to everyone.

"Seventh level" is an existence that this group of little mercenaries can only look up to. The adventurers here are not even the highest level of the fourth level, and they can't even take a move from others.

The rule of respecting the strong appears here again.

The beauty in red snorted softly: "A bunch of weaklings."

The beauty in red moved her steps slightly and came to the counter, only to see an ordinary fair face with black hair?Their eyes met, the pretty face of the red-dressed beauty became angry, and she said in a cold voice: What are you looking at?"

“Look at your breasts..Forehead..What do you do?" Before Liu Feng could finish his words, he saw the beautiful woman fanning her face with a jade hand. Liu Feng's skill and eyesight had improved a lot after practicing inner martial arts for several days. He tilted his head slightly and dodged.

Seeing that the blow missed, the beauty was slightly surprised. She grabbed Liu Feng's wrist with her left hand like lightning, lifted it, swung it again, and threw it heavily to the ground.

The beauty in red snorted coldly: "It turns out that he is a "magical useless person" and he is still so arrogant."

"MD, labor and management are looking for the badge on your chest, not you, silly bitch."Liu Feng raised his head and said angrily. Indeed, Liu Feng was telling the truth. What he just looked at was the badge on her chest, which was a beautifully carved blue star.

The beauty in red raised her eyebrows and moved her lips, but did not make a sound. Maybe in her eyes, a useless man with magic and martial arts was not worth wasting her words.

He walked past Liu Feng, suddenly paused, took out a few gold coins from his pocket and threw them under his body.

She was originally kind-hearted, but she didn't know that this action was even more insulting in Liu Feng's heart than before.

Anger surged in his heart, his fists were clenched, and his nails dug deeply into his palms. Looking at the gold coins swirling in front of his eyes, they seemed to turn into mocking smiles.

A thought suddenly popped up in my mind, "Rush up, fight her, and make her pay the price for insulting you."Although Liu Feng wanted to do this, his reason quickly told him that his current strength was no match for her. After thinking for a moment, Liu Feng chose to endure. He deeply understood the truth, "A gentleman takes revenge, and it is never too late in ten years."

He stood on the ground with one hand, wiped away a trace of blood from the corner of his mouth, and said in a cold voice to the beauty in red: "The humiliation today will be repaid tenfold in the future."

Hearing these words that were bone-chilling, a hint of uneasiness and anxiety suddenly flashed through the heart of the purple-clothed beauty..Afraid?

Her beautiful eyes flickered, as if she wanted to speak out, but in the end her arrogance prevented her from speaking, and she just nodded lightly.
